preamble.title: kshot3000/plutusshield
preamble.description: PlutusShield Cardano validators: underwriting pool, policy NFTs, parametric depeg settlement

cardano/address/Address.title: Address
cardano/address/Address.description:
A Cardano `Address` typically holding one or two credential references.

 Note that legacy bootstrap addresses (a.k.a. 'Byron addresses') are
 completely excluded from Plutus contexts. Thus, from an on-chain
 perspective only exists addresses of type 00, 01, ..., 07 as detailed
 in [CIP-0019 :: Shelley Addresses](https://github.com/cardano-foundation/CIPs/tree/master/CIP-0019/#shelley-addresses).

cardano/address/Credential.title: Credential
cardano/address/Credential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/PaymentCredential.title: PaymentCredential
cardano/address/PaymentCredential.description:
A general structure for representing an on-chain `Credential`.

 Credentials are always one of two kinds: a direct public/private key
 pair, or a script (native or Plutus).

cardano/address/StakeCredential.title: StakeCredential
cardano/address/StakeCredential.description:
Represent a type of object that can be represented either inline (by hash)
 or via a reference (i.e. a pointer to an on-chain location).

 This is mainly use for capturing pointers to a stake credential
 registration certificate in the case of so-called pointer addresses.

cardano/transaction/OutputReference.title: OutputReference
cardano/transaction/OutputReference.description:
An `OutputReference` is a unique reference to an output on-chain. The `output_index`
 corresponds to the position in the output list of the transaction (identified by its id)
 that produced that output

plutusshield/committee/Committee.title: Committee
plutusshield/committee/Committee.description: `threshold` distinct signatures out of `assessors` release a payout.

anyOf.title: Apply
anyOf.description: Anyone applies the pending change once its delay has passed.

anyOf.title: Cancel
anyOf.description: Current committee (threshold signatures) withdraws a pending change.

anyOf.title: InitCommittee
anyOf.description: Mint the committee NFT once, consuming the seed UTxO.

plutusshield/committee/PendingChange.title: PendingChange
plutusshield/committee/PendingChange.description: A proposed committee and the earliest time it may be applied.

plutusshield/types/AssetClass.title: AssetClass
plutusshield/types/AssetClass.description: A native asset identifier. `AssetClass { policy_id: "", asset_name: "" }` is ada.

plutusshield/types/AssetTerms.title: AssetTerms
plutusshield/types/AssetTerms.description:
One accepted pool currency. Its position in `CoverParams.assets` is the
 tranche index used by redeemers, the pool datum, and the LP token name.

fields.title: asset
fields.description: `AssetClass { "", "" }` for ada, or e.g. USDCx `1f3aec8b…7e34.USDCx`.

fields.title: min_premium
fields.description: Premium floor in this asset's base units (5 ADA = 5_000_000 lovelace).

fields.title: min_deposit
fields.description:
Smallest LP deposit accepted, in this asset's base units. Stops anyone
 from jamming the single pool UTxO with a stream of dust deposits while
 claimants race to settle. Must be >= 1.

plutusshield/types/CoverParams.title: CoverParams
plutusshield/types/CoverParams.description: Validator parameters. Applied once at deployment; there is no admin key.

fields.title: seed
fields.description: UTxO consumed to mint the unique pool NFT (one-shot).

fields.title: assets
fields.description:
Accepted currencies for LP capital, premiums, and payouts, one tranche
 each. Distinct, non-empty, at most 255 (tranche index fits a byte).

fields.title: claim_grace_ms
fields.description:
After expiry, how long a holder still has to submit a claim for a
 trigger window that ended on or before expiry.

fields.title: sale_guard
fields.description: Circuit-breaker applied to every `Buy`.

fields.title: pool_min_lovelace
fields.description:
Lovelace that always stays in the pool UTxO as its ledger min-UTxO. It
 is never counted as ada-tranche capital, so the initializer's min-ada
 isn't donated to the first LP and the last LP can withdraw 100%.

plutusshield/types/Feed.title: Feed
plutusshield/types/Feed.description:
One allowlisted oracle feed, run by one operator.

 A feed reading is a UTxO, used as a reference input, that
   - holds exactly one token under `policy_id` (named `name`) and no other
     token under that policy, and
   - sits at an address whose payment credential is the `operator` key,
 so only the operator (who controls both the feed policy and the address)
 can publish or update it. Every feed has its own operator key and its own
 policy: one compromised key can never speak for two feeds.

anyOf.title: InitPool
anyOf.description: Mint the pool NFT once, consuming `seed`.

anyOf.title: ViaPool
anyOf.description: Any LP-share or policy-token mint/burn. Validated by the pool spend.

anyOf.title: BurnUserTokens
anyOf.description: A holder may always burn their own policy user tokens (e.g. after expiry).

plutusshield/types/OracleConfig.title: OracleConfig
plutusshield/types/OracleConfig.description:
Which oracle feeds are trusted, and how many distinct operators must
 agree. `params_ok` requires at least 3 feeds with distinct operators and
 distinct policies, and a strict-majority `quorum` (2-of-3, 3-of-5, ...).
 Feeds are counted by operator, so one key can never count twice.

plutusshield/types/PolicyDatum.title: PolicyDatum
plutusshield/types/PolicyDatum.description: State of one policy, carried by the UTxO holding its reference token.

fields.title: policy_id
fields.description:
32 bytes: blake2b_256(cbor(pool output reference consumed at purchase)).
 Same id the Midnight `policy-cover` registry is keyed by.

fields.title: asset
fields.description:
Currency of `coverage`, `premium`, and the payout. Must be one of
 `CoverParams.assets`; it selects the tranche the policy draws on.

fields.title: midnight_commitment
fields.description:
32-byte Midnight registration commitment made by the buyer:
 registrationCommitment(policy_id, holder, coverage) in
 `policy-cover.compact`, which `registerPolicy` checks.

fields.title: refund_to
fields.description:
Who gets the policy reference UTxO's min-ada back when the policy is
 retired by `Expire`. Set by the buyer at purchase (normally their own
 wallet address). `Expire` can be submitted by anyone, but must pay this
 address at least the reference UTxO's lovelace.

anyOf.title: Deposit
anyOf.description: LP adds capital to `tranche`; that tranche's LP shares minted pro rata.

anyOf.title: Withdraw
anyOf.description:
LP burns `shares` of `tranche` for their pro-rata capital in that asset,
 subject to the tranche's capital lock.

anyOf.title: Buy
anyOf.description:
Buyer pays the premium, in the policy's asset, into that tranche and
 mints a policy (ref + user token). Needs fresh healthy-peg readings
 from every allowlisted feed and respects the waiting period (`CoverParams.sale_guard`).

anyOf.title: Settle
anyOf.description: Holder burns the policy and receives `coverage` from its tranche.

anyOf.title: Expire
anyOf.description:
Anyone retires one or more policies after expiry + grace, unlocking
 their capital. Each reference UTxO's min-ada goes back to its own
 `PolicyDatum.refund_to`, in an output tagged with that policy's id
 (inline datum = policy_id), so one refund can never satisfy two policies.

plutusshield/types/PoolDatum.title: PoolDatum
plutusshield/types/PoolDatum.description:
State of the underwriting pool, carried by the UTxO holding the pool NFT.
 `tranches[i]` is the ledger for `CoverParams.assets[i]`.

plutusshield/types/ProductTerms.title: ProductTerms
plutusshield/types/ProductTerms.description:
One product line per deployment. Mirrors `packages/sdk` PRODUCTS + quote
 engine constants, converted to integer basis points.

fields.title: product_id
fields.description: "depeg" | "exploit" | "sla" (matches SDK ProductId)

fields.title: base_rate_bps
fields.description: Base annual premium rate, e.g. 200 = 2.00%.

fields.title: risk_mult_bps
fields.description: Risk-tier multiplier for the covered asset: A 8_000, B 10_000, C 15_000.

fields.title: max_single_policy_bps
fields.description: One policy can take at most this share of pool capital (1_000 = 10%).

fields.title: max_utilization_bps
fields.description: Active cover can never exceed this share of capital (9_000 = 90%).

plutusshield/types/SaleGuard.title: SaleGuard
plutusshield/types/SaleGuard.description:
Sale circuit-breaker. Stops buyers from purchasing cover into a depeg that
 is already under way (adverse selection).

fields.title: waiting_period_ms
fields.description:
Minimum gap between the latest moment a `Buy` can land (its validity
 upper bound) and the policy's `start`. A depeg that begins inside this
 gap is never covered, because trigger windows must start at or after
 `start`. 0 disables the waiting period.

fields.title: max_price_age_ms
fields.description:
A `Buy` must reference EVERY allowlisted feed (not just a quorum, so a
 buyer can't omit one that shows a depeg), each reporting a healthy peg
 (`price_bps >= trigger.threshold_bps`) with a `window_end` no older than
 this, measured from the Buy's validity upper bound. Must be > 0: the
 check is always on.

plutusshield/types/Tranche.title: Tranche
plutusshield/types/Tranche.description:
Ledger of one tranche. Its capital is the quantity of the tranche asset
 held by the pool UTxO itself (for ada: the pool UTxO's lovelace minus
 `CoverParams.pool_min_lovelace`).

fields.title: total_shares
fields.description: Outstanding LP share tokens of this tranche (`lp` ‖ tranche index byte).

fields.title: active_cover
fields.description: Sum of coverage across live policies in this asset.

plutusshield/types/Trigger.title: Trigger
plutusshield/types/Trigger.description:
The objective condition a parametric policy pays out on.

 Depeg example: `covered_asset` = "USDM", `threshold_bps` = 9_500 (price
 below 0.95 of peg), `window_ms` = 86_400_000 (for at least 24h).
